paite: Israel mite aw, ngaikhia un, nou sang a thupizaw leh thilhih-theizaw namte, khopi van sun a kulh daikaih leh thupi luah ding in tuni in Jordan galkah a, na kuan ding uh ahi.
heading: Mipite Thumanlouhna
english: Hear, Israel! You are to pass over the Jordan today, to go in to dispossess nations greater and mightier than yourself, cities great and fortified up to the sky,

paite: "Milian leh sang, Anakte, Anak suante ma ah kua adingh zou dia?" achih uh na theih uh leh zaksa uh ahi.
english: a people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, whom you know, and of whom you have heard say, “Who can stand before the sons of Anak?”

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh katmang hat mei bang a na ma ua pai ahi, chih tuni in thei un. Ama'n amaute ahihmangthang dia, ahon hihniamsak ding. Huchi in TOUPA'N na kiang ua agensa bang in, amau na delhkhe ding ua, na hihmangthang pah ding uhi.
english: Know therefore today that Yahweh your God is he who goes over before you as a devouring fire. He will destroy them and he will bring them down before you. So you shall drive them out and make them perish quickly, as Yahweh has spoken to you.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon delhkhiaksak khit chiang in, "I diktat ziak a hiai luah dia TOUPA'N hon pilut ahi, na lungsim un chi kei hial un." Hiai namte agitlouh ziak un ahi zaw, TOUPA'N hon delhkhiaksak ding.
english: Don’t say in your heart, after Yahweh your God has thrust them out from before you, “For my righteousness Yahweh has brought me in to possess this land;” because Yahweh drives them out before you because of the wickedness of these nations.

paite: Na diktat ziak uh hiam, na lungsim uh dik ziak hiam in, agam uh na luah kei ding ua, hiai namte gitlouhna ziak leh TOUPA'N na pu uh Abraham, Isak leh Jakob kiang a, akichiamna hihkip ding in TOUPA na Pathian un amau hon delhkhiaksak ahi zaw hi.
english: Not for your righteousness or for the uprightness of your heart do you go in to possess their land; but for the wickedness of these nations Yahweh your God does drive them out from before you, and that he may establish the word which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

paite: Huaiziak in hiai gam hoih mahmah na diktat ziak ua luah ding in TOUPA'N hon pia ahi kei chih thei un. Nam genhakpi lah na hi ngal ua.
english: Know therefore that Yahweh your God doesn’t give you this good land to possess for your righteousness, for you are a stiff-necked people.

paite: Gamdai a TOUPA na hehsak nak dante uh theigige unla, mangngilh kei un. Aigupta gam a pan na pawt ni ua kipan hiai mun na hong tun tan un TOUPA tung a helhat na hi uhi.
english: Remember, and don’t forget, how you provoked Yahweh your God to wrath in the wilderness. From the day that you left the land of Egypt until you came to this place, you have been rebellious against Yahweh.

paite: Horeb ah leng TOUPA na hehsak ua, nou hon hihmangthang ding khop hial in TOUPA aheh hi.
english: Also in Horeb you provoked Yahweh to wrath, and Yahweh was angry with you to destroy you.

paite: Suangpek, na kiang ua TOUPA'N thu akhunna suangpek la dia tang a ka va hohtouh lai in, tang ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli ka va om a; tanghou ka ne kei a, tui leng ka dawn sam kei hi.
english: When I had gone up onto the mountain to receive the stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant which Yahweh made with you, then I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water.

paite: TOUPA'N suangpek nih, Pathian khutzung a gelh ahon pia a; huai ah na kikhopkhawm ni ua tang tung a mei a pan TOUPA'N na kiang ua thu agen tengteng atuang hi.
english: Yahweh delivered to me the two stone tablets written with God’s finger. On them were all the words which Yahweh spoke with you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire in the day of the assembly.

paite: Ni sawmli leh zan sawmli khit in hichi ahong hi a, suangpek nih, thukhun suangpek ahon pia hi.
english: It came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights that Yahweh gave me the two stone tablets, even the tablets of the covenant.

paite: TOUPA'N ka kiang ah, "Thou inla, hiai a pan paisuk meng in, Aigupta gam a pan na pikhiak na mite akihihse khinta uh. Zuih dia ka hon thupiak lampi a pan apialmangta ua, milim suntawm akibawl uh," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to me, “Arise, get down quickly from here; for your people whom you have brought out of Egypt have corrupted themselves. They have quickly turned away from the way which I commanded them. They have made a molten image for themselves!”

paite: Huaite ban ah, "TOUPA'N, hiai mite ka etet aleh, ngai in, nam genhak ahi uh.
english: Furthermore Yahweh spoke to me, saying, “I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people.

paite: Amau hihmangthang ding leh van nuai a pan amin uh thaimang ding in ka hih dandan in ka hih mai ding. Amau sang a nam thilhihtheizaw leh thupizaw in nang ka hon bawl ding," chi in leng hon houpih lai hi.
english: Leave me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under the sky; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they.”

paite: Huchi in tang a pan ka kihei a, ka paisuk a, tang akangta, thukhun suangpek nihte ka khut langnih in ka tawi hi.
english: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire. The two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.

paite: Huchi in ka en a, ngai un, TOUPA na Pathian uh tung ah na khialta uhi. Bawngnou lim suntawm na kibawl ua; TOUPA'N thu ahon piak lampi na pialsanta uhi.
english: I looked, and behold, you had sinned against Yahweh your God. You had made yourselves a molded calf. You had quickly turned away from the way which Yahweh had commanded you.

paite: Suangpek nihte ka dom a, ka khut langnih a pan ka pai a, na mitmuh un ka hihkhamta hi.
english: I took hold of the two tablets, and threw them out of my two hands, and broke them before your eyes.

paite: Tuma a ka hih bang in TOUPA ma ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli ka bokkhup hi. Amah hihheh dia TOUPA mitmuh a na thilhihkhelhsa uh, nou khelhna tengteng ziak in tanghou ka ne kei a, tui leng ka dawn sam kei hi.
english: I fell down before Yahweh, as at the first, forty days and forty nights. I neither ate bread nor drank water, because of all your sin which you sinned, in doing that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.

paite: Nou hon hihmangthang dia TOUPA hehna, athangpaihna leh alungkimlouhna mahmah lah ka lau ngal a. Himahleh huai lai in leng TOUPA'N ka thu hon ngaihkhiaksak hi.
english: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure with which Yahweh was angry against you to destroy you. But Yahweh listened to me that time also.

paite: TOUPA bel Aaron hihmangthang nuam hial khop in aheh a; himahleh Aaron mah leng ka thumsak pah ngal hi.
english: Yahweh was angry enough with Aaron to destroy him. I prayed for Aaron also at the same time.

paite: Na khelhna uh ziak a na bawl uh bawngnou lim ka la a, ka hal a, ka satzan a, leivui bang in ka gawinel dimdem a; tang a pan a lui hong luang ah anel ka pai hi.
english: I took your sin, the calf which you had made, and burned it with fire, and crushed it, grinding it very small, until it was as fine as dust. I threw its dust into the brook that descended out of the mountain.

paite: Taberah, Massah leh Kibroth-hattaavah ah leng TOUPA na hihheh uhi.
english: At Taberah, at Massah, and at Kibroth Hattaavah you provoked Yahweh to wrath.

paite: TOUPA'N, k'on gam piak va luah un, chi a, Kadesh-barnea a pan ahon sawl lai in, TOUPA na Pathian uh thupiak na helsan ua, amah na gingta kei ua, a-aw lah na ngaikhe sam kei uh.
english: When Yahweh sent you from Kadesh Barnea, saying, “Go up and possess the land which I have given you,” you rebelled against the commandment of Yahweh your God, and you didn’t believe him or listen to his voice.

paite: K'on theih tung a pan TOUPA tung a helhatmi na hi gige uh.
english: You have been rebellious against Yahweh from the day that I knew you.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N, ka hihmangthang ding, ahon chih ziak in TOUPA ma ah ni sawmli leh zan sawmli sung ka bokkhup hi.
english: So I fell down before Yahweh the forty days and forty nights that I fell down, because Yahweh had said he would destroy you.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah ka thum a, "Toupa PATHIAN aw, na thupina a tat, khut hattak a Aigupta gam a pan na tatkhiak, na mite leh na goutante hihmangthang ke'n.
english: I prayed to Yahweh, and said, “Lord Yahweh, don’t destroy your people and your inheritance that you have redeemed through your greatness, that you have brought out of Egypt with a mighty hand.

paite: Na sikha Abraham, Isak leh Jakob theigige inla, hiai mite phengphitdan, gitlouhdan leh akhelhdante uh en ke'n.
english: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob. Don’t look at the stubbornness of this people, nor at their wickedness, nor at their sin,

paite: Huchi lou in zaw na hon pikhiakna gam a mite'n TOUPA'N agam chiam a apilut theih louh ziak leh amuhdah ziak in gamdai a thah ding in apikhia, achi kha ding uh.
english: lest the land you brought us out from say, ‘Because Yahweh was not able to bring them into the land which he promised to them, and because he hated them, he has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.’

paite: Na thilhihtheihna thupitak leh na ban zak a na pikhiak, na mite leh na goutante lah ahi ngal ua," ka chi hi.
english: Yet they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out by your great power and by your outstretched arm.”
